title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: PDU session establishment procedure
entities.description: Procedure for establishing a PDU session between UE and network.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request PDU session establishment.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by network to reject PDU session establishment.

entities.name: DL NAS TRANSPORT
entities.description: Downlink NAS transport message carrying PDU session establishment accept.

entities.name: SM PDU DN request container
entities.description: Information element containing PDU session authentication and authorization information for external DN.

entities.name: Initial emergency request with existing emergency PDU session
entities.description: Condition where received request type is initial emergency request and another emergency PDU session already exists for UE.

entities.name: PDU DN authentication information non-compliant
entities.description: Condition where PDU session authentication/authorization information in SM PDU DN request container is not compliant with local policy and subscription data.

entities.name: Duplicate PDU session ID with initial request
entities.description: Condition where PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST has PDU session ID identical to existing PDU session and request type is initial request or initial emergency request.

entities.name: Non-existent PDU session for existing request
entities.description: Condition where request type is existing PDU session or existing emergency PDU session but SMF has no information about that PDU session.

entities.name: DL NAS TRANSPORT message not forwarded
entities.description: Condition where SMF determines DL NAS TRANSPORT message carrying PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT was not forwarded to UE by 5G access network.

entities.name: SMF rejects PDU session establishment
entities.description: SMF behavior to reject PDU session establishment with specific 5GSM cause.

entities.name: SMF releases existing PDU session
entities.description: SMF behavior to locally release existing PDU session.

relations.description: Condition where initial emergency request with existing emergency PDU session leads to SMF rejecting PDU session establishment.
Condition where non-compliant PDU DN authentication information leads to SMF rejecting PDU session establishment with cause #29.
Condition where duplicate PDU session ID with initial request leads to SMF releasing existing PDU session.
Condition where non-existent PDU session for existing request leads to SMF rejecting PDU session establishment with cause #54.
Condition where DL NAS TRANSPORT message not forwarded leads to SMF rejecting PDU session establishment with cause #26.
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message contains SM PDU DN request container IE.
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message is used when SMF rejects PDU session establishment.
DL NAS TRANSPORT message is part of PDU session establishment procedure carrying PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT ACCEPT.
